other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Charmakar community
Applicant must have knowledge of the business for which the loan is sought
Income must be below the poverty line for the 50% Subsidy Scheme and Margin Money
For NSFDC scheme, income must be below ₹98,000 in rural areas or below ₹1,20,000 in urban areas
Applicant must provide an Income Certificate and a Caste Certificate issued by an authorized government officer
benefits_summary: Offers term loans of ₹1,00,000‑₹2,50,000 covering up to 75% of project cost with interest rates of 7‑8% per annum and repayment periods of up to 60 months.
